course.title: Database System
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A University maintains data about the following entities ;
(i) Course including course number, title, credit, references, instructor-id, domain.
(ii) Course offering including course number, year, term, section number, timing and class room.
(iii) Students including student-id, name and department.
(iv) Instructor including instructor-id, name, department and title. Develop an ER diagram for the system.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
